description: §5.2.3 — a BARE `;`-sequence handler on a button inside an `<each>` row fires E-MULTI-STATEMENT-HANDLER. Pre-S437 impl#1 re-parsed the `<each>` body and discarded every TAB error from that re-parse, so even the call-led form compiled at exit 0 there.
rationale: §5.2.3: "A BARE event-handler value that contains a `;` outside of expression-internal contexts … is compile error `E-MULTI-STATEMENT-HANDLER`." The rule has no positional exemption; §5.2.3 names the `<each>` row (§17.7) as a position whose handlers follow the same rules as top level.
